notes.title: Hard Mode Update
notes.notes:
UPDATE


 Added Fast Forward
 Made it obvious who you need for a region
 Added Hard Mode Difficulty
 Fixed some obscure bugs


______________________

Thanks everyone who bought the game on Steam, I really appreciate it. It's fun to see people discussing the game in discussions and discord, I apologize that some parts are rough around the edges. If you get stuck anywhere in the game perhaps I can try and give some advice and strategies but I think it's often more fun to work it out on your own. 

I don't recommend playing hard mode on your first playthrough, it's really brutally difficult. But I thought it would be a good addition to the game. Especially for the minmaxers like me. 

Cheers,

Richard
